description: Add or remove Pulp repos from a remote host.

parameters.name: add_export_distributor
parameters.description: Whether or not to add the export distributor to new rpm repositories. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: client_cert
parameters.description: PEM formatted certificate chain file to be used for SSL client authentication. This file can also include the key as well, and if the key is included, client_key is not required.

parameters.name: client_key
parameters.description: PEM formatted file that contains your private key to be used for SSL client authentication. If client_cert contains both the certificate and key, this option is not required.

parameters.name: feed
parameters.description: Upstream feed URL to receive updates from.

parameters.name: feed_ca_cert
parameters.description: CA certificate string used to validate the feed source SSL certificate. This can be the file content or the path to the file.

parameters.name: feed_client_cert
parameters.description: Certificate used as the client certificate when synchronizing the repository. This is used to communicate authentication information to the feed source. The value to this option must be the full path to the certificate. The specified file may be the certificate itself or a single file containing both the certificate and private key. This can be the file content or the path to the file.

parameters.name: feed_client_key
parameters.description: Private key to the certificate specified in feed_client_cert, assuming it is not included in the certificate file itself. This can be the file content or the path to the file.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: If yes do not get a cached copy. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: force_basic_auth
parameters.description: httplib2, the library used by the ansible.builtin.uri module only sends authentication information when a webservice responds to an initial request with a 401 status. Since some basic auth services do not properly send a 401, logins fail. This option forces the sending of the Basic authentication header upon initial request. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: generate_sqlite
parameters.description: Boolean flag to indicate whether sqlite files should be generated during a repository publish. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: http_agent
parameters.description: Header to identify as, generally appears in web server logs. Default: "ansible-httpget"

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the repo to add or remove. This correlates to repo-id in Pulp.

parameters.name: proxy_host
parameters.description: Proxy URL setting for the pulp repository importer. This is in the format scheme://host.

parameters.name: proxy_password
parameters.description: Proxy password for the pulp repository importer.

parameters.name: proxy_port
parameters.description: Proxy port setting for the pulp repository importer.

parameters.name: proxy_username
parameters.description: Proxy username for the pulp repository importer.

parameters.name: publish_distributor
parameters.description: Distributor to use when state=publish. The default is to publish all distributors.

parameters.name: pulp_host
parameters.description: URL of the pulp server to connect to. Default: "https://127.0.0.1"

parameters.name: relative_url
parameters.description: Relative URL for the local repository. It’s required when state=present.

parameters.name: repo_type
parameters.description: Repo plugin type to use (that is, rpm, docker). Default: "rpm"

parameters.name: repoview
parameters.description: Whether to generate repoview files for a published repository. Setting this to true automatically activates generate_sqlite. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: serve_http
parameters.description: Make the repo available over HTTP. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: serve_https
parameters.description: Make the repo available over HTTPS. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The repo state. A state of sync queues a sync of the repo. This is asynchronous but not delayed like a scheduled sync. A state of publish uses the repository’s distributor to publish the content. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent" "sync" "publish"

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: HTTP, HTTPS, or FTP URL in the form (http|https|ftp)://[user[:pass]]@host.domain[:port]/path

parameters.name: url_password
parameters.description: The password for use in HTTP basic authentication to the pulp API. If the url_username parameter is not specified, the url_password parameter is not used.

parameters.name: url_username
parameters.description: The username for use in HTTP basic authentication to the pulp API.

parameters.name: use_gssapi
parameters.description: Use GSSAPI to perform the authentication, typically this is for Kerberos or Kerberos through Negotiate authentication. Requires the Python library gssapi to be installed. Credentials for GSSAPI can be specified with url_username/url_password or with the GSSAPI env var KRB5CCNAME that specified a custom Kerberos credential cache. NTLM authentication is not supported even if the GSSAPI mech for NTLM has been installed. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: use_proxy
parameters.description: If no, it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: If false, SSL certificates are not validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: wait_for_completion
parameters.description: Wait for asynchronous tasks to complete before returning. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
- name: Create a new repo with name 'my_repo'
  community.general.pulp_repo:
    name: my_repo
    relative_url: my/repo
    state: present

- name: Create a repo with a feed and a relative URL
  community.general.pulp_repo:
    name: my_centos_updates
    repo_type: rpm
    feed: http://mirror.centos.org/centos/6/updates/x86_64/
    relative_url: centos/6/updates
    url_username: admin
    url_password: admin
    force_basic_auth: true
    state: present

- name: Remove a repo from the pulp server
  community.general.pulp_repo:
    name: my_old_repo
    repo_type: rpm
    state: absent

return_values.name: repo
return_values.description: Name of the repo that the action was performed on. Returned: success Sample: "my_repo"
